variables.physical_definition: First-order absolute moment (arithmetic mean of absolute deviations) of surface height fluctuations; a characteristic roughness height.
Peak-to-valley height: vertical distance between the highest peak and lowest valley of the surface profile.
Root-mean-square height of the surface profile; the square root of the mean of squared height deviations.
Skewness of height fluctuations: the third central moment divided by the cube of the RMS height (dimensionless measure of asymmetry).
Kurtosis of height fluctuations: the fourth central moment normalized by the fourth power of the RMS height (dimensionless measure of peakedness/tail weight).
Effective streamwise slope of the roughness: dimensionless measure of average slope in the streamwise direction (rise/run).
Surface porosity: fraction of surface area that is open/void (dimensionless between 0 and 1).

Perform dimensional analysis for sand-grain roughness parameterization to derive the dimensionless relationship governing the normalized equivalent sand-grain roughness (denoted as ks/Ra).

the first-order absolute moment of height fluctuations, Ra;
the peak-to-valley height, kt;
the root-mean-square height, k_rms;
the third central moment of roughness height fluctuations divided by the cube of their root-mean-square height, Sk;
the kurtosis of roughness height fluctuations, Ku;
the effective streamwise slope of the roughness, ES;
the surface porosity, Po.
